facts.claim: A Bayesian meta-analysis yields a posterior probability of 6–12% that current LLMs are conscious.
facts.quote: A Bayesian meta-analysis using an extremely skeptical prior (0. 1%) and conservative dependency assumptions yields posterior probability of 6–12% that current LLMs are conscious.

facts.claim: Generative AI applications in artistic and creative domains are materially impacting digital creative domains.
facts.quote: These intelligent interactive systems, shaped by innovations in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Language Models (VLMs), are materially impacting digital creative domains.

research.angle: While LLMs are materially impacting digital creative domains and can improve specific creativity metrics in students, they often fail to sustain novelty and diversity across extended contexts.
research.verdict: The evidence shows that generative AI acts as a catalyst for human creativity and impacts digital domains, but it currently struggles with sustained novelty.
research.caveat: The studies focus on human-AI interaction and specific educational contexts rather than the underlying computational linguistics of predicting statistical probabilities of novelty.
